hooks.name: on-parity-verify
hooks.description: Before the agent stops, run the differential prover on every sample with 1,000 vectors. A session may not end with a lifter that disagrees with its interpreter.

action.command: in=$(cat); echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) on-parity-verify stdin=$(printf %s "$in" | tr -d "\n" | head -c 500)" >> benchmarks/hook-firings.log; cargo run --quiet --release --bin necro-cli -- benchmark --vectors 1000 --rom-steps 200 | tail -n 20
